sn35.63:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo yena Bhagavā || la || 3
sn35.63:1.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Migajālo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.63:1.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante ekavihārī hoti || kittāvatā ca pana Sadutiyavihārī hoti || || 4
sn35.63:2.1: Santi kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.63:2.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.63:2.3: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.63:2.6: nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho Migajāla bhikkhu sadutiyavihārīti vuccati || 5-6 ||
sn35.63:2.8: Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.63:2.9: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato || tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi || nandiyā sati sārāgo hoti || Sārāge sati saṃyogo hoti || nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho Migajāla bhikkhu sadutiyavihārīti vuccati || || la || 9 Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.63:2.10: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.63:2.13: nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho Migajāla bhikkhu sadutiyavihārīti vuccati || || 10
sn35.63:2.14: Evaṃvihārīca Migajāla bhikkhu kiñcāpi araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallāṇasāruppāni ||
sn35.63:3.1: Santi ca kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantāmanāpāpiyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.63:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nā ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.63:3.3: tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati ||
sn35.63:3.6: nandisaṃyojanavisaṃyutto kho Migajāla bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati || la || 15-16
sn35.63:3.7: Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā || la || 17
sn35.63:3.8: Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.63:3.9: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.63:3.10: tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati ||

sn35.63:3.14: Evaṃvihārī ca Migajāla bhikkhu kiñcāpi gāmante viharati ākiṇṇe bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi ||
